Dear investor,

Halden Group is a limited partner in Kestrel Partners Fund IV. This letter is about Harbourline Foods and the partial sale Kestrel has agreed with Northshore Consumer Partners.

On 17 June 2026 Kestrel agreed to sell a 60 percent stake in Harbourline Foods to Northshore Consumer Partners at an enterprise value of GBP 420 million. Kestrel will retain a 40 percent stake. The sale is expected to complete in the third quarter.

Harbourline produces chilled ready meals, pies and side dishes for grocery retailers in the United Kingdom and Ireland, from sites in Yorkshire and County Cork. Kestrel invested in 2020, when Harbourline was a family owned business. Since then the company has secured listings with five of the six largest UK grocers and the three largest Irish retailers, more than doubled its revenue, and doubled the capacity of its Cork site. A newly automated production line in Yorkshire is now fully operational.

In the quarter to 30 June 2026 Harbourline reported record volumes, launched a new range of premium ready meals, and secured a listing with a sixth major UK retailer. Its valuation was marked up by 22 percent to the agreed transaction value.

At 30 June 2026 the fund's net asset value stood at EUR 652 million. The fund reports an IRR of 15.9 percent. We will write again when Kestrel reports on the stake it holds.

Yours sincerely,

Halden Group

London, 17 June 2026 - Kestrel Partners today announced that Kestrel Partners Fund IV has agreed to sell a 60% stake in Harbourline Foods Limited ("Harbourline"), the UK and Irish chilled prepared foods producer, to Northshore Consumer Partners. The transaction values Harbourline at an enterprise value of GBP 420 million. Kestrel Partners Fund IV will retain a 40% stake and continue to support the business alongside Northshore and the management team.

Harbourline produces chilled ready meals, pies and side dishes for major grocery retailers in the United Kingdom and Ireland from sites in Yorkshire and County Cork. When Kestrel invested in 2020, Harbourline was a family-owned business supplying a handful of regional retailers. Under Kestrel's ownership the company has secured national listings with five of the six largest UK grocers and the three largest Irish retailers, more than doubled its revenue, doubled the capacity of its Cork site and invested in automated production lines that have lifted on-time, in-full delivery rates to over 98%.

Claire Dunmore, Chief Executive of Harbourline, said: "Kestrel backed us to transform from a regional supplier into a national partner to the UK and Irish grocers. We are excited to welcome Northshore, whose experience in branded and private-label food will support our next stage of growth."

James Kerr, Managing Partner at Kestrel Partners, said: "Harbourline is a great example of our approach of backing strong management teams to professionalise and scale. We are proud of what the team has achieved and are pleased to remain a significant shareholder as Harbourline enters its next chapter with Northshore."
About Kestrel Partners

Kestrel Partners invests in European software and technology-enabled services businesses, as well as selected consumer and industrial companies, with enterprise values between EUR 100 million and EUR 600 million. Founded in 2008, Kestrel has offices in London, Amsterdam and Stockholm and manages over EUR 3 billion across four funds.

London, 17 June 2026 - Kestrel Partners today announced that Kestrel Partners Fund IV has agreed to sell a 60% stake in Harbourline Foods Limited ("Harbourline"), the UK and Irish chilled prepared foods producer, to Northshore Consumer Partners. The transaction values Harbourline at an enterprise value of GBP 420 million. Kestrel Partners Fund IV will retain a 40% stake and continue to support the business alongside Northshore and the management team.

Harbourline produces chilled ready meals, pies and side dishes for major grocery retailers in the United Kingdom and Ireland from sites in Yorkshire and County Cork. When Kestrel invested in 2020, Harbourline was a family-owned business supplying a handful of regional retailers. Under Kestrel's ownership the company has secured national listings with five of the six largest UK grocers and the three largest Irish retailers, more than doubled its revenue, doubled the capacity of its Cork site and invested in automated production lines that have lifted on-time, in-full delivery rates to over 98%.

Claire Dunmore, Chief Executive of Harbourline, said: "Kestrel backed us to transform from a regional supplier into a national partner to the UK and Irish grocers. We are excited to welcome Northshore, whose experience in branded and private-label food will support our next stage of growth."

James Kerr, Managing Partner at Kestrel Partners, said: "Harbourline is a great example of our approach of backing strong management teams to professionalise and scale. We are proud of what the team has achieved and are pleased to remain a significant shareholder as Harbourline enters its next chapter with Northshore."
About Kestrel Partners

Kestrel Partners invests in European software and technology-enabled services businesses, as well as selected consumer and industrial companies, with enterprise values between EUR 100 million and EUR 600 million. Founded in 2008, Kestrel has offices in London, Amsterdam and Stockholm and manages over EUR 3 billion across four funds.

The transaction values Harbourline at an enterprise value of GBP 420 million. Kestrel Partners Fund IV will retain a 40% stake and continue to support the business alongside Northshore and the management team.

Harbourline produces chilled ready meals, pies and side dishes for major grocery retailers in the United Kingdom and Ireland from sites in Yorkshire and County Cork. When Kestrel invested in 2020, Harbourline was a family-owned business supplying a handful of regional retailers. Under Kestrel's ownership the company has secured national listings with five of the six largest UK grocers and the three largest Irish retailers, more than doubled its revenue, doubled the capacity of its Cork site and invested in automated production lines that have lifted on-time, in-full delivery rates to over 98%.

Claire Dunmore, Chief Executive of Harbourline, said: "Kestrel backed us to transform from a regional supplier into a national partner to the UK and Irish grocers. We are excited to welcome Northshore, whose experience in branded and private-label food will support our next stage of growth."

James Kerr, Managing Partner at Kestrel Partners, said: "Harbourline is a great example of our approach of backing strong management teams to professionalise and scale. We are proud of what the team has achieved and are pleased to remain a significant shareholder as Harbourline enters its next chapter with Northshore."
About Kestrel Partners

Kestrel Partners invests in European software and technology-enabled services businesses, as well as selected consumer and industrial companies, with enterprise values between EUR 100 million and EUR 600 million. Founded in 2008, Kestrel has offices in London, Amsterdam and Stockholm and manages over EUR 3 billion across four funds.

Under Kestrel's ownership the company has secured national listings with five of the six largest UK grocers and the three largest Irish retailers, more than doubled its revenue, doubled the capacity of its Cork site and invested in automated production lines that have lifted on-time, in-full delivery rates to over 98%.

Claire Dunmore, Chief Executive of Harbourline, said: "Kestrel backed us to transform from a regional supplier into a national partner to the UK and Irish grocers. We are excited to welcome Northshore, whose experience in branded and private-label food will support our next stage of growth."

James Kerr, Managing Partner at Kestrel Partners, said: "Harbourline is a great example of our approach of backing strong management teams to professionalise and scale. We are proud of what the team has achieved and are pleased to remain a significant shareholder as Harbourline enters its next chapter with Northshore."
The transaction is expected to complete in the third quarter of 2026, subject to customary regulatory approvals.

Kestrel Partners invests in European software and technology-enabled services businesses, as well as selected consumer and industrial companies, with enterprise values between EUR 100 million and EUR 600 million. Founded in 2008, Kestrel has offices in London, Amsterdam and Stockholm and manages over EUR 3 billion across four funds.
To:              Halden Group (Investor ID KP4-0217)
In accordance with Clause 9 of the Limited Partnership Agreement of Kestrel Partners Fund IV SCSp (the "Fund"), the General Partner is pleased to advise you of the following distribution.

Partial realisation of Harbourline Foods Limited. On 30 September 2026 the Fund completed the sale of a 60% shareholding in Harbourline Foods Limited to Northshore Consumer Partners. The Fund retains a 40% shareholding. The realisation generated a gross multiple of 2.8x on the cost of the shares sold.
Distributions to date (including this notice)      30,200,000
Payment will be made on 20 October 2026 to the account on file. Please notify Kestrel Investor Services of any change to your bank details before 15 October 2026.

Aurelia continued to roll out its rostering platform at existing hospital group customers and signed one new customer in the Netherlands. The valuation was held broadly flat. Management is assessing several small add-on opportunities in the Nordic region.

occurrences.extract: London, 17 June 2026 - Kestrel Partners today announced that Kestrel Partners Fund IV has agreed to sell a 60% stake in Harbourline Foods Limited ("Harbourline"), the UK and Irish chilled prepared foods producer, to Northshore Consumer Partners. The transaction values Harbourline at an enterprise value of GBP 420 million. Kestrel Partners Fund IV will retain a 40% stake and continue to support the business alongside Northshore and the management team.

Harbourline produces chilled ready meals, pies and side dishes for major grocery retailers in the United Kingdom and Ireland from sites in Yorkshire and County Cork. When Kestrel invested in 2020, Harbourline was a family-owned business supplying a handful of regional retailers. Under Kestrel's ownership the company has secured national listings with five of the six largest UK grocers and the three largest Irish retailers, more than doubled its revenue, doubled the capacity of its Cork site and invested in automated production lines that have lifted on-time, in-full delivery rates to over 98%.

Claire Dunmore, Chief Executive of Harbourline, said: "Kestrel backed us to transform from a regional supplier into a national partner to the UK and Irish grocers. We are excited to welcome Northshore, whose experience in branded and private-label food will support our next stage of growth."

James Kerr, Managing Partner at Kestrel Partners, said: "Harbourline is a great example of our approach of backing strong management teams to professionalise and scale. We are proud of what the team has achieved and are pleased to remain a significant shareholder as Harbourline enters its next chapter with Northshore."
The transaction is expected to complete in the third quarter of 2026, subject to customary regulatory approvals.

Kestrel Partners invests in European software and technology-enabled services businesses, as well as selected consumer and industrial companies, with enterprise values between EUR 100 million and EUR 600 million. Founded in 2008, Kestrel has offices in London, Amsterdam and Stockholm and manages over EUR 3 billion across four funds.
In accordance with Clause 9 of the Limited Partnership Agreement of Kestrel Partners Fund IV SCSp (the "Fund"), the General Partner is pleased to advise you of the following distribution.

Partial realisation of Harbourline Foods Limited. On 30 September 2026 the Fund completed the sale of a 60% shareholding in Harbourline Foods Limited to Northshore Consumer Partners. The Fund retains a 40% shareholding. The realisation generated a gross multiple of 2.8x on the cost of the shares sold.
Of which recallable under Clause 9.4 of the LPA:        50,000,000           2,000,000
Payment will be made on 20 October 2026 to the account on file. Please notify Kestrel Investor Services of any change to your bank details before 15 October 2026.

Fund IV delivered a solid second quarter, with net asset value up 3.4% before cash flows. The highlight was Harbourline Foods, which reported record volumes and, on 17 June, agreed the sale of a 60% stake to Northshore Consumer Partners at a valuation well above our carrying value.

Harbourline had an outstanding quarter. Volumes reached a record level following the launch of a new range of premium ready meals with two national grocers, and the company secured a listing with a sixth major UK retailer. The newly automated production line in Yorkshire is now fully operational. On 17 June we agreed the sale of a 60% stake to Northshore Consumer Partners, valuing Harbourline at an enterprise value of GBP 420 million; completion is expected in the third quarter, subject to regulatory approvals. We have revalued Harbourline to the agreed transaction value, an increase of 22% in the quarter, and it was the main contributor to the Fund's NAV growth.

Aurelia continued to roll out its rostering platform at existing hospital group customers and signed one new customer in the Netherlands. The valuation was held broadly flat. Management is assessing several small add-on opportunities in the Nordic region.

Brightwater traded in line with the first quarter. The contract with its largest customer, a national testing network, comes up for renewal in the third quarter, and management is in discussions on terms. Brightwater's valuation was unchanged.
Other holdings
We are in advanced discussions on a new platform investment in Nordic logistics software and expect to update you in the coming months.

The agreed partial sale of Harbourline will return significant capital to investors following completion, and we continue to see an attractive pipeline of new opportunities for the remaining investment period.
The Kestrel Partners team
The firm has agreed the transaction.
